title: Street Sweeping - Thoroughfares
description: Use this request to report sweeping needed on major thoroughfares ONLY, no residential streets, private property or parking lots. If a Hazard (such as, glass or other harmful debris) exists on a residential street call 3-1-1 and refer to Street Spillage/Debris in Right-of-Way – Hazardous, and city crews will respond. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days. NOTE: Sweeping is completed once a month along the scheduled route, weather permitting. The city has a systematic cleaning schedule that covers all major traffic thoroughfares within Dallas. Cleaning includes sweeping along the curb line at each location.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for debris sweeping on a major thoroughfare.
actions.why: For routine sweeping of dirt, leaves, mud, rocks, sand, small tree twigs, or another debris type along a major Dallas thoroughfare. The 311 request form asks whether the street is a major thoroughfare or residential and, for a major thoroughfare, what debris is present; city routes are swept about once a month, weather permitting.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Street Sweeping - Thoroughfares" requests is not for residential streets, private property, or parking lots. If a hazard such as glass or other harmful debris is on a residential street, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online, and ask about "Street Spillage/Debris in Right-of-Way - Hazardous".
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Street Sweeping - Thoroughfares"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Street Sweeping - Thoroughfares"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a hazardous spill or debris on a residential street.
actions.why: For a hazard such as glass or other harmful debris on a residential street. The description for "Street Sweeping - Thoroughfares" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs residents to call 311 and refer to "Street Spillage/Debris in Right-of-Way - Hazardous". The description for "Street Spillage/Debris in Right of Way" requests on the Dallas 311 website covers hazardous spills or debris blocking a public right-of-way.
actions.how: Call 311 and refer to a "Street Spillage/Debris in Right of Way" request
